_comment: The evaluation run configuration: default.json's canonical task graph on the
backend and model the energy constants were derived for.
Why this file exists separately from default.json: default.json carries the
canonical *task graph* but ollama/qwen2.5-coder:3b LLM settings, which are dev
defaults. scripts/chatai.json carries chatai settings but a stale graph. Neither
is the configuration the thesis run needs, and assembling it by hand each time is
how a run ends up unattributable.
The model is NOT a free choice. evaluation/energy.config.json's coefficients were
derived for devstral-2-123b-instruct-2512 specifically (123B parameters, FP8, 2x
H200 - confirmed by GWDG 2026-08-22). Running a different model and costing the
result with these constants would put every energy figure in the thesis on
coefficients belonging to something else. If the model changes, energy.config.json
must change with it.
Apply with: ./scripts/reconfigure.sh scripts/benchmark.json
or let scripts/run-benchmark.sh do it: ./scripts/run-benchmark.sh <dir> -c scripts/benchmark.json

tasks._comment: pyScan is required here, unlike the dev pipeline: a benchmark job without a feature vector is a row [I4] cannot use, and discovering that after a 3-hour run is worse than failing fast.

_comment: maxRetryCount 4 is measured, not guessed. Marginal builds per attempt
over run 20260831-190900's 95 functions: attempt 1 -> 48, 2 -> +19,
3 -> +6, 4 -> +2. Every attempt still pays, so cutting to 3 would cost
two functions; attempt 5 is untested but the trend (40% -> 21% -> 12%
hit rate) does not argue for it.
The cost of a high ceiling is bounded by the stagnation guard, not by
this number: a job that keeps reproducing the same failure is aborted
at the 3rd repeat regardless.
testRouter, not goTester: 40 of the 95 evaluation_set functions declare
setup/sideEffects and can only be validated through the Floci route.
Naming goTester directly would send them to the black-box tester, which
ignores those assertions with a warning and reports a pass that
validated nothing.
maxRetryCount 5, measured over run 20260831-190900: attempt 1 -> 29
passes, 2 -> +6, 3 -> +5, 4 -> +2, 5 -> +0 (2 jobs reached it, both
failed). Attempt 5 is the only one in the pipeline with a measured yield
of zero, but on n=2, so it is kept rather than trimmed for a saving of
roughly 0.6% of run tokens. Revisit once the Floci endpoint fix
([C11a]) has been run: 23 of the 30 jobs that exhausted this budget
were Floci-route jobs failing on AWS credentials, so this curve was
measured through a defect that no longer exists.
